edits.text: 火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. In one oracle-bone passage, the name is tentatively identified as 火星; other interpretations identify it as 大火, or 心宿二. Why the star was called 火 is unresolved.

The star-name use is distinct from the literal sense ‘fire’. Interpretations of the oracle-bone passage differ in how specifically they identify the star: one tentatively reads 火星, while others identify 大火, or 心宿二. The evidence does not explain why the star was called 火 or how its name relates to ‘fire’.
